window_note: Daily OHLC for SPCX from listing. The figure runs from the offer to the window end, which is meant to be the first post-IPO earnings release (Q2 2026), after which new fundamental information breaks the hold-fundamentals-fixed inversion. Open/high/low/close/volume are written automatically by fetch_series.py from the Nasdaq official historical API (api.nasdaq.com), the source of record, cross-checked against an independent Yahoo 1-minute reconstruction. The events list is user-editable; 'expected' dates are estimates to confirm, and Nasdaq-100 entry is a review outcome, not a certainty. CRSP/Russell additions are expected to fall in the September reconstitution, outside this window, so they are not listed.
